audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart all 'Skill' while content win[0..6] and packet levelChart both read Naafiri on every row; spikes[1] and other spike fields use the fabricated name 'RE-Defiant Dance'.
audit.why: Defiant Dance is Irelia's W. Karma's E is Inspire (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s); Mantra-E is the shield spike. Sides flipped to Naafiri to agree with win[] (side-only edits — win[] already correct).
audit.corrected: See edits: chart sides, spikes[1], spikes[3], late, wants.you[1], wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated ability name 'RE-Defiant Dance' throughout content; 'Hound's Pursuit' misspelt (correct: Hounds' Pursuit); dosFull[2].d claims a 'fifteen-second invitation' — Focused Resolve is 12s flat; no cooldown numbers in breakdown.cooldowns.
audit.why: Karma kit: Q Inner Flame 9-5s, W Focused Resolve 12s tether/root that also reveals (and heals on Mantra — anti-heal matters), E Inspire shield 10-8s, Mantra 40-34s recharged by damaging abilities. Naafiri Q daggers are projectiles Karma cannot block; her W tether-root is the one button that stops the W dive.
audit.corrected: Names and numbers fixed across both layers.

audit.why: Missing-interaction flags Karma Mantra-W self-heal — report[8] itemization lacked anti-heal; added a Grievous Wounds clause within band.
